description: This file defines data structures for container configuration according to the Open Container Initiative (OCI) runtime spec, including platform-specific settings for Linux, Solaris, Windows, z/OS, FreeBSD, and VM configurations, as well as seccomp syscall restrictions.

classes.name: Spec
classes.description: Represents the base configuration for a container, including platform-specific options.

classes.name: Scheduler
classes.description: Defines scheduling attributes for a process, based on Linux sched_setattr.

classes.name: Process
classes.description: Contains information to start a specific application inside the container.

classes.name: LinuxCapabilities
classes.description: Specifies the list of Linux capabilities kept for a process.

classes.name: LinuxIOPriority
classes.description: Represents I/O priority settings for container processes.

classes.name: Box
classes.description: Defines dimensions of a rectangle, used for console size.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Specifies user and group information for the container process.

classes.name: Root
classes.description: Contains information about the container's root filesystem.

classes.name: Mount
classes.description: Defines a mount point inside the container.

classes.name: Hook
classes.description: Specifies a command to run at a specific container lifecycle event.

classes.name: Hooks
classes.description: Contains lifecycle hooks for container setup and teardown.

classes.name: Arch
classes.description: Represents additional architectures for seccomp filtering.

classes.name: LinuxSeccompAction
classes.description: Actions taken upon seccomp rule match.

classes.name: LinuxSeccompFlagSpecAllow
classes.description: Flag to disable speculative store bypass mitigation.

classes.name: FreeBSDSharing
classes.description: Controls sharing of features in FreeBSD containers.
